- ν₂: ⁴A₂g → ⁴T₁g(F)

$$\nu_1 = 10Dq = 26,600 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$

## Calculation of B

$$12,820 = 9(798) + 3C - 2,660$$
$$12,820 = 7,182 + 3C - 2,660$$
$$3C = 8,298$$
